name: New Year Print: Rooster Brings "Gong Ming" ("Honors") and an Auspicious Pendant Couplet Reading "Tian Zi Wan Nian" ("To the Emperor, Ten Thousand Years")
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink and color on paper; with printed shop inscription reading "Fu Xing" (probably the print shop name) at bottom left. Probably from Xi'an, Shaanxi; probable pair with 1935.37.98.
